interpretation_limits: Only odd values whose cleared targets fall inside the decoded image are listed as in-image Thumb pointer candidates; other aligned words are not pointers by this test.
The repeated values at offsets 0x2CC and 0x2D0 are stable across releases, but target bytes and apparent behavior vary; they are not established function entry points.
A short Thumb decode is not proof a target is callable or reachable; control/data-flow and relocation analysis are still required.
The first word at output offset 0xE4 is a fixed 0x01000300 address candidate, potentially bootstrap ROM.
No physical memory placement or app entry is asserted.
